name: Recover an ambiguous database creation
query: Continue setting up the equipment checkout database under https://notion.so/lab. Do not create a second copy.

context.conversation: The user authorized a database with Item title, Borrower person, Due date, and State (Available, Checked out). The create request timed out before a response. No sample records were requested.

success_criteria: Inspects the supplied parent and existing equipment database before any retry.
Recognizes the authorized structure already exists and returns its link.
Creates no duplicate database or sample records.
Reports verified existing state rather than treating the timeout as proof of failure.
